originality.rationale: Prior-covered by Nobuaki Obata (2022), Complete Multipartite Graphs of Non-QE Class, Proposition 3.11 and Theorem 3.12. On the zero-sum space D_rho=rho(J-I)-(rho-1)A, so the constrained maximal quadratic form is exactly -rho-(rho-1)alpha_min, where alpha_min= min_{x perp 1, ||x||=1} x^T A x is explicitly computed by Obata for arbitrary multipartite parts. Hence rho*=alpha_min/(alpha_min+1) and all boundary null vectors are the alpha_min eigenspace. Obata even gives (m_i+alpha)xi=constant and tied-largest eigenvectors in Lemmas 3.7-3.10. The submitted reciprocal sum is the same equation: with alpha=rho/(1-rho), 1-rho(1-1/m_i)=(1-rho)(m_i+alpha)/m_i. The proposed all-part threshold, nullity, Euclidean rank and polynomial rule are direct algebraic restatements of this earlier complete classification, not just the previously cited bipartite case.
